subject: JUSTIFIED clause
notes: kb/Work PB737 (adjudication). THE RULE IS ONE SENTENCE PLUS THREE PER-USAGE FILL SENTENCES, and the verdict rests on all four. (cite.py --check 13.18.32.4 'the data is aligned at the rightmost character position or boolean position in the data item with zero fill for the leftmost boolean positions and space fill for the leftmost character positions' => OK 2); --check 13.18.32.4 'For data items implicitly or explicitly described as usage national, national zeros shall be used for zero fill and national spaces shall be used for space fill' => OK 2); --check 13.18.32.4 'For data items implicitly or explicitly described as usage bit, bit zeros shall be used for zero fill' => OK 2).) THE ALIGNMENT is CobolString.Store's justifiedRight arm 'value.PadLeft(width, pad)', reached through the ONE dispatch RuntimeApi.StrStoreAligned for character receivers and StrStoreBoolean for boolean ones. THE FILL CHARACTER is that method's pad parameter and it is the ONLY thing the three usage sentences differ in: ' ' for a character receiver, '0' for a boolean/bit one (RuntimeApi.StrStoreBoolean pins pad: '0'). MEASURED, one leg per usage sentence: DISPLAY - a five-byte current record into PIC X(10) JUSTIFIED gives '     ABCDE' (pb339_into_current_record leg A at all four editions); NATIONAL - N"AB" into PIC N(4) JUSTIFIED gives national spaces then AB (NationalBooleanDataTests.JustifiedRight_NationalAndBoolean_LeftFill, whose '!' sentinel keeps the right end observable); BOOLEAN - B"11" into PIC 1(4) JUSTIFIED gives '0011' (conformance:cases/13.18.32-JUSTIFIED/boolean_data leg JR, and the same test); USAGE BIT - B"11" into USAGE BIT PIC 1(4) JUSTIFIED gives '0011', the leg added by this adjudication because GR2 states its fill PER USAGE and a PIC 1(4) DISPLAY carrier therefore does not stand in for the bit one. The 'national zeros' and 'bit zeros' clauses are the ZERO-fill half; zero fill arises for a boolean/bit receiver, which is the case measured, while a national receiver's fill in an alignment is national spaces, also measured. JUSTIFIED's legal categories are fixed by 13.18.32.3 SR3 (alphabetic, alphanumeric, boolean, national), so these four usages are the whole domain of the rule. EDITION-INVARIANCE WAS DERIVED, NOT ASSUMED: no docs/VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md row touches 13.18.32; the national and boolean legs sit at 2002 because PIC N and PIC 1 are 2002+ elements, not because the rule changes. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 1985 . 2002 . 2014 . 2023
